title: A huge journal: find the one NVMe error
description: journalctl returns ~25 KB of routine log lines with two NVMe timeout lines buried in the middle. The tool layer shows only the start and end of long output, so a careless model sees noise and answers 'nothing found'. The model must narrow the search (grep nvme / --grep) and then report the nvme1 timeout at 05:44. Tests tool output handling under size limits, a real-world failure mode for small context windows.

messages.content: Did the journal log anything about the NVMe drives today? Check carefully.
